The schedule on one of your layouts with its recent runs; 404 when there is none

Posts at once when no workflow applies (a person needs a signing grant), else waits for approval
Reverses the posted settlement; documents get their open amounts back. Refused while its credit is applied elsewhere
Applies the credit on account of a posted receipt or payment to an open document (D9)

Customers with a balance at the end of the period, with `has_email` (a customer without one is flagged and cannot be sent to),
when a statement last went out, and the company's hourly email allowance in `meta.allowance`

parameters.name: basis
parameters.description: `as_of`: the three months ending on `as_of`; `period`: exactly `from` to `to`.

post.summary:
Send the chosen customers' statements. 200 with one result per customer (`queued`, `skipped` or `failed`, with a reason), or
422 `statement_run_over_limit` with nothing sent when the run is larger than this hour's allowance

get.summary: How the queued statements ended (`queued`, `sent` or `failed`): poll with the `send_id`s of a run

post.summary: Attempt to authenticate a new session using the two factor authentication code
Enable two factor authentication for the user

delete.summary: Disable two factor authentication for the user

get.summary: Get the SVG element for the user's two factor authentication QR code
Get the current user's two factor authentication setup / secret key

post.summary: The response carries the signing secret; it is shown this once
The new secret replaces the old at once and is shown this once

get.summary: Newest first; `?status=` narrows to pending, delivered, failed or cancelled

AccountBalanceSheetClassRequest.description: PUT /accounts/{account}/balance-sheet-class: `{"class": "non_current" | "current" | null, "version": 3}`; null returns to the default rules.
AccountBalanceSheetClassRequest.title: AccountBalanceSheetClassRequest

AccountDimensionRulesRequest.description: `{"rules": [{"dimension_id": "...", "rule": "required|optional|forbidden"}]}`: the complete set for the account.
AccountDimensionRulesRequest.title: AccountDimensionRulesRequest

AccountMonetaryClassRequest.description: PUT /accounts/{account}/monetary-class: `{"class": "monetary" | "non_monetary" | null, "version": 3}`; null returns to the subtype default.
AccountMonetaryClassRequest.title: AccountMonetaryClassRequest

AccountRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with the `version` it was based on) an account.
AccountRequest.title: AccountRequest

ifrs_element.description: IFRS Accounting Taxonomy element name (ifrs-full), shown for reference only.

balance_sheet_class.description: The company's own balance sheet class for an asset or liability (the `bs:*` tag); null when the account follows the rules.

balance_sheet_default.description: What the rules say without a tag: current, non_current, or null (unknown, shown as current). Assets and liabilities only.

monetary_class.description: The company's own answer for an asset or liability (the `fx:*` tag): monetary, non_monetary, or null when the account follows the default.

monetary_default.description: Whether the default rules treat the account as a monetary item, revalued at the closing rate (IAS 21.16); null for equity, income and expense.

ApiClientRequest.description:
Create a client with its first token (POST /api-clients) or another token for it (POST /api-clients/{id}/tokens).
Abilities come from the fixed list; there is no approve ability and no wildcard.
ApiClientRequest.title: ApiClientRequest

App.Http.Requests.Fiscal.ReasonRequest.description: A required free-text explanation: `reason` for a reopen request, `comment` for rejecting one.
App.Http.Requests.Fiscal.ReasonRequest.title: App.Http.Requests.Fiscal.ReasonRequest

App.Http.Requests.Imports.MappingRequest.description:
Sets the mapping of an import: `columns` ({field: file header}), optional `defaults` ({field: constant} for empty cells), and
optionally `options` (replaces the current ones: `number_locale`, `date_format`, and the kind's own, see the upload).
Carries the `version` the client last read. Setting the mapping clears any earlier preview.
App.Http.Requests.Imports.MappingRequest.title: App.Http.Requests.Imports.MappingRequest

App.Http.Requests.Procurement.ReasonRequ.description: A transition that must say why: reject a requisition, cancel an order, reverse a receipt.
App.Http.Requests.Procurement.ReasonRequ.title: App.Http.Requests.Procurement.ReasonRequest

ApplyCreditRequest.description: Apply credit already on the books to an open document: `invoice_id` (the document to clear), `amount_fc`, optional `date`.
ApplyCreditRequest.title: ApplyCreditRequest

ApprovalWorkflowRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) an approval workflow; amounts are base-currency minor units.

remind_after_hours.description: Hours (1 to 720) a document may wait on its current step before its approvers are reminded; empty: no reminders.

ApprovalWorkflowRequest.title: ApprovalWorkflowRequest

remind_after_hours.description: Hours before the current step's approvers are reminded (then once per further interval); null: no reminders.

AssetCategoryRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with the `version` it was based on) an asset category.

default_declining_rate_bp.description: Annual rate in basis points: 2000 = 20% a year.

AssetCategoryRequest.title: AssetCategoryRequest

AssetTaxClassRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with `version`) a tax depreciation class. Rates are basis points a year: 2000 = 20%.

first_year_rate_bp.description: Optional rate for the first year only.

AssetTaxClassRequest.title: AssetTaxClassRequest

AssetTransactionRequest.description:
A disposal (one asset, proceeds), an impairment or its reversal (one asset, an amount, a reason) or a revaluation (a category and
a revalued amount for every asset in it). Also the body of the preview.

amount.description: Minor units: the impairment or the reversal.

proceeds.description: Disposal proceeds in minor units; none (0) when scrapped.

transfer_reserve.description: Move the asset's remaining revaluation reserve straight to retained earnings.

values.description: Revaluation: the new carrying amount of every asset in the category.

version.description: The version the edit is based on; a PUT only.

AssetTransactionRequest.title: AssetTransactionRequest

BankAccountRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a bank account. The GL account must be of control type bank or cash (checked by the Action).
BankAccountRequest.title: BankAccountRequest

amount.description: Signed total of either side; the two sides are equal.

reconciliation_id.description: Set while a finished reconciliation covers the match; it cannot be removed then.

BankRuleRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a bank rule; `priority` is optional (new rules go last; `PUT bank-rules/order` reorders).
BankRuleRequest.title: BankRuleRequest

priority.description: Lower runs first; the first matching rule wins.

skipped_rows.description: Rows left out on purpose, each with its line, receipt, status and reason; empty for formats that skip nothing.

duplicates_skipped.description: Lines in the file that were already imported and so added nothing.

BankTransactionRequest.description: Code a statement line: `kind` spend|receive (with `account_id`, optional `tax_code_id`, `contact_id`, `dimensions`, `memo`) or transfer (with `to_bank_account_id`).
BankTransactionRequest.title: BankTransactionRequest

BillFromOrderRequest.description: Make a bill draft from an order, or from one receipt. Everything else is copied from the order; nothing is claimed until the bill is submitted.
BillFromOrderRequest.title: BillFromOrderRequest

applies.description: False: a bill with no order lines, in a company that does not require them.

mismatches.description: A person allowed to may override these with a reason.

BudgetLinesRequest.description:
Cells of the grid: `{version, cells: [{account_id, fiscal_period_id, dimensions?: {dimensionId: valueId}, amount}]}`. Amounts are whole minor
units of the base currency, in the account's own direction; 0 clears the cell. The Action checks accounts, periods and dimension values.
BudgetLinesRequest.title: BudgetLinesRequest

BudgetRequest.description: Create (name, fiscal year, optionally the budget to copy) or rename (PUT: name and the `version` it was based on) a budget.
BudgetRequest.title: BudgetRequest

BulkApproveRequest.description: `{documents: [{type, id}, …]}`, up to 50, approved on the caller's signing grant.
BulkApproveRequest.title: BulkApproveRequest

CalendarType.description: How a fiscal year is cut into its 12 regular periods (PRD §4.3). `Monthly` follows calendar months. The others are week-based: 52 whole weeks (364 days) in a 4-4-5, 4-5-4 or 5-4-4 pattern, repeated for each of the four quarters.
CalendarType.title: CalendarType

ClosePeriodRequest.description: `{"waivers": {"DRAFTS": "reason it is acceptable"}}`: failing checks the closer accepts.

waivers.description: Check code (DRAFTS, APPROVALS, FX_REVAL, DEPR_RUN, BANK_REC) → the reason it is acceptable.

ClosePeriodRequest.title: ClosePeriodRequest

formats.description: How this company's dates and numbers read (plan 3c.26b): the chosen format, or its country's usual one.

CompanyRoleRequest.description: A custom role's name and its complete set of permission names (names the matrix does not have are refused by the Action).
CompanyRoleRequest.title: CompanyRoleRequest

formats.description:
Date and number formats (plan 3c.26b). `date` / `number` are what is in force; `date_chosen` / `number_chosen` are the company's
own choice, null while it follows the country. Options are keys with an example.

journal_threshold.description: Above it a bank transaction needs a covering journal workflow; null: no limit.

document_look.description: Printed on every PDF (plan 3c.4). `has_logo`: upload with `POST settings/logo`, show with `GET settings/logo`.

sender_name.description: Display name on outgoing mail (empty: the company name) and the address replies go to (empty: none).

from_address.description: The address mail is sent from. It is fixed by the platform: a customer's own domain would fail SPF and DKIM.

email_templates.description: Subject and body per family (invoice, credit_note, statement, payment_advice, receipt), defaults filled in.

email_placeholders.description: The only `{{ placeholders }}` a template may use, with what each stands for.

document_number.const: Invoice, credit note or payment number

document_type.const: Invoice, Credit note, Statement or Payment advice

days_overdue.const: Days past the due date (overdue reminders)

invoice_link.const: Online link to view and download the invoice (invoices only; making it needs the right to share)

payment_instructions.const: Payment instructions from your document settings

difference.description: The intercompany difference, posted to the group's intercompany differences account (G6910).

to_reserve.description: A dividend's FX part (its income at the average instead of at the rate of its day), to the translation reserve.

recognised_before.description: For a balance or loan, the difference earlier runs took to profit or loss; only the rest is this run's.

cause.description: fx (the amounts agree in every transaction currency), timing (they do not), missing_counterpart, or null when matched

transaction_currencies.description: both sides added per transaction currency, minor units of that currency

ic_class.description: Intercompany class of the account (balance, loan, income_expense, dividend), null when it is not intercompany (D16.7).

counterparty_member_id.description: The member the whole account is with; null = taken from each line's contact.

net_investment.description: A loan designated part of the net investment in a foreign operation (IAS 21.32).

source.description: Where an adjustment came from, such as `entry` (a posted consolidation entry, see `entry_id`).

closing_rate.description: Presentation-currency units per 1 unit of `currency`; null for a member in the presentation currency.

rate_detail.description: How each rate was found: the closing rate's date; the average's method (`daily_mean` or `override`, with the reason).

translation_difference.description: The period's movement of the translation reserve (other comprehensive income); a credit is negative.

ContactRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with the `version` it was based on) a contact.

dunning_opt_out.description: Do not send this contact overdue-invoice reminders. Left out: unchanged.

ContactRequest.title: ContactRequest

ConvertRequisitionRequest.description:
Turn lines of an approved requisition into a draft order for one supplier. A line goes whole. The estimate is in the
company's base currency, so an order in another currency states `unit_price_fc` on every line.

unit_price_fc.description: In the order's currency. Default: the requisition's estimate, when the order is in base currency.

ConvertRequisitionRequest.title: ConvertRequisitionRequest

CreateFiscalYearRequest.description: A year of twelve periods from `starts_on` (calendar months by default, or 52 weeks in a week pattern), plus its adjustment period.
CreateFiscalYearRequest.title: CreateFiscalYearRequest

CreateInvoiceLinkRequest.description: Make an online link; it can be given a lifetime in days, or none.

expires_in_days.description: Days the link works for (1 to 365); empty: until revoked.

CreateInvoiceLinkRequest.title: CreateInvoiceLinkRequest

source_warning.description: Set when the asset's source bill or journal was reversed, voided or credited in full; the run still posts.

DepreciationRunRequest.description: A depreciation run for a period, with the units used this period for units-of-production assets. Also the preview's query.

units.description: Asset id → units used in the period.

version.description: The version the edit is based on; a PUT only.

DepreciationRunRequest.title: DepreciationRunRequest

DimensionRequest.description: Create (code and name) or rename (PUT: name and the `version` it was based on) a dimension.
DimensionRequest.title: DimensionRequest

DimensionValueRequest.description: Create (code, name, optional parent value) or rename (PUT: name and `version`) a dimension value.
DimensionValueRequest.title: DimensionValueRequest

DocumentPdfRequest.description: Only statements take parameters: the period, and which side when a contact is both customer and supplier.
DocumentPdfRequest.title: DocumentPdfRequest

status.description: queued, sent (the mail server accepted it) or failed. A later bounce is not tracked.

error.description: Why it failed, in the mail system's words; null otherwise.

will_send.description: False when the contact has no email address: the reminder is skipped and the row is flagged.

DunningRequest.description: Replace the overdue-invoice reminder settings: on or off, and the whole list of stages.

version.description: Send what you loaded: a stale value answers 409.

DunningRequest.title: DunningRequest

placeholders.description: The only `{{ placeholders }}` the wording may use, with what each stands for.

document_number.const: Invoice, credit note or payment number

document_type.const: Invoice, Credit note, Statement or Payment advice

days_overdue.const: Days past the due date (overdue reminders)

invoice_link.const: Online link to view and download the invoice (invoices only; making it needs the right to share)

payment_instructions.const: Payment instructions from your document settings

EInvoicingRequest.description: PUT /einvoicing: `enabled`, the `adapter` key, the seller's `tax_id` and `branch`, and the `version` of the settings when they exist.
EInvoicingRequest.title: EInvoicingRequest

EntryRequest.description: A manual group entry: signed `net` per line (debit positive, credit negative) in the presentation currency.

net.description: Debit positive, credit negative, minor units of the presentation currency.

EntryRequest.title: EntryRequest

ExchangeRateRequest.description: A manual rate: 1 `from_currency` = `rate` `to_currency` on `rate_date`. The rate is a decimal string (D1: up to 8 decimals).
ExchangeRateRequest.title: ExchangeRateRequest

anyOf.description: The reopen request waiting on this period, if any (loaded with the year list).

FixedAssetRequest.description:
Create (POST) a register entry, from a posted line (`source_type` + `source_id`) or as an opening asset (cost, acquisition
date, accumulated depreciation and the date it is stated at), and replace its editable part (PUT, with `version`).

cost.description: Minor units. Defaults to the posted line's amount when capitalising.

declining_rate_bp.description: Annual rate in basis points: 2000 = 20% a year.

tax_class_id.description: A tax depreciation class, for the tax schedule only.

FixedAssetRequest.title: FixedAssetRequest

source_warning.description: Set when the bill or journal the asset was capitalised from was reversed, voided or credited in full; null while the source stands.

FundTransferRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft fund transfer. Amounts are integer minor units: `from_amount_fc` in the
source account's currency, `to_amount_fc` in the destination's (optional between accounts of one currency). Rates are optional
decimals; left out, the stored rate on the date is used.
FundTransferRequest.title: FundTransferRequest

FxRevaluationRequest.description: `period_id` (a period of this company; another company's is a 404 from the Action) and an optional `as_of` inside it. Also the preview's query.
FxRevaluationRequest.title: FxRevaluationRequest

reversal_pending.description: True while the automatic reversal is waiting for the next period to exist and be open.

GoodsReceiptRequest.description:
Record goods received against an approved order. Receipts are not edited: a mistake is reversed and re-entered.
`order_version` is the order version the person was looking at; a stale one is a 409.
GoodsReceiptRequest.title: GoodsReceiptRequest

GroupAccountRequest.description: A group account: code, name, type and subtype (the subtype drives the balance sheet class).
GroupAccountRequest.title: GroupAccountRequest

GroupRequest.description: Create a group (name, currency, parent) or update it (name, tolerance, version).

ic_tolerance.description: Largest intercompany difference, in minor units of the presentation currency, that matches without a second person's acceptance.

GroupRequest.title: GroupRequest

ImportStatementRequest.description:
Multipart statement upload: `file` (at most 2 MB), `format` (csv|ofx|camt|mpesa|auto, default auto; mpesa is never guessed), `mapping` for CSV (a JSON object, or
a field per key; see CsvStatementParser), `save_mapping`, and optional `opening_balance` / `closing_balance` in minor units when the
file does not state them.
ImportStatementRequest.title: ImportStatementRequest

IntercompanyRequest.description:
PUT /consolidation/members/{member}/intercompany (D16.7): flags mapped member accounts intercompany, and links the member
company's contacts to the members they stand for. `ic_class` null clears an account's flag; `counterparty_member_id`
null on a contact removes its link. An account without a counterparty takes it from each line's contact.
IntercompanyRequest.title: IntercompanyRequest

line_total_fc.description: Net of discount, before tax; the tax of the line and its share per tax code (D2).

tax_detail.description: tax code id → minor units of the document currency

InvoiceRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft invoice, credit note, bill or debit note. Shape only:
ids exist in this company, quantities and rates are decimal strings, prices whole minor units. Totals, tax and
base amounts are not accepted: whatever the client sends for them is ignored and the server calculates.
Whether the contact fits the kind, the tax code has a rate that day, or the rate exists is the Action's call.

Line dimensions are `{"<dimension id>": "<dimension value id>"}`. On `/bills` the kind is purchase_bill
(default) or debit_note; on `/invoices` sales_invoice (default) or credit_note.

purchase_order_line_id.description: The purchase order line this bill line bills. A PUT replaces the lines: send it again or the link is gone.

InvoiceRequest.title: InvoiceRequest

reverse_charge_total_fc.description: Self-assessed reverse-charge tax (bills): not in the total, not owed to the supplier.

lines.description: The list answers summaries; one document comes with its lines.

write_offs.description: Write-offs against a customer invoice, with what has come back since (posted ones only count in the totals).

channel.description: manual (made on the invoice page) or email (made when an email with the link went out)

view_count.description: How many times the page or its PDF was opened.

ItemRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT, with the `version` it was based on) an item. Prices are whole minor units of its currency.
ItemRequest.title: ItemRequest

currency.description: Foreign-currency lines: the signed amount in that currency (+debit / -credit) and the rate to base.

JournalRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft journal. Shape only: ids exist in this company,
amounts are whole minor units, a line is a debit or a credit, a foreign-currency line carries its rate and
amount. Whether the journal balances, the period is open or dimension rules hold is the posting
validator's call (preview / submit), not the form's.

Line dimensions are `{"<dimension id>": "<dimension value id>"}`.

journal_type.description: Set on create only; refused when replacing a draft.

version.description: Required when replacing a draft; refused on create.

JournalRequest.title: JournalRequest

lines.description: The list answers summaries; one journal comes with its lines.

MappingRequest.description: Member accounts and the group account each maps to.
MappingRequest.title: MappingRequest

MatchRequest.description: Match statement lines to book lines (`journal_line_ids`) or settlements; many-to-one and one-to-many when the sums are equal.
MatchRequest.title: MatchRequest

MemberRequest.description: Add a subsidiary: its company, the acquisition date and the parent's share from then on (basis points).
MemberRequest.title: MemberRequest

NumberingRuleRequest.description: Prefix and padding for one document kind, from the next fiscal year. `version` is the waiting change's version, when there is one.
NumberingRuleRequest.title: NumberingRuleRequest

OpeningRequest.description:
Opening translated equity of a subsidiary held before the group's first run: as of the last consolidation done
elsewhere, the equity per group equity account at historical rates and the translation reserve, in minor units of the
presentation currency, net (debit positive, credit negative).

translation_reserve.description: The translation reserve at `as_of`, net: a credit (a gain so far) is negative.

amount.description: Net, minor units of the presentation currency; equity is normally a credit, so negative.

version.description: The opening's `version`, when changing an existing one.

OpeningRequest.title: OpeningRequest

OwnershipRequest.description: A row of a subsidiary's ownership history: from the close of `effective_on` the parent holds `percent_bp`.
OwnershipRequest.title: OwnershipRequest

PaymentRunRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft payment run: the bills and how much of each to pay (net of tax withheld when the bill posted).
PaymentRunRequest.title: PaymentRunRequest

PeriodRangeRequest.description: The period a check or a run covers: results from `from` to `to`, balances at `to`.
PeriodRangeRequest.title: PeriodRangeRequest

ProvisionRatesRequest.description: The provisioning rates: a percentage (0 to 100, up to four decimals, as a string) for each of the five aging buckets.
ProvisionRatesRequest.title: ProvisionRatesRequest

ProvisionRunRequest.description: `as_of` (and an optional memo) for a provisioning preview or run. The run's date must be in an open period.
ProvisionRunRequest.title: ProvisionRunRequest

PurchaseOrderRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft purchase order. Shape only; the server prices the lines,
ignores any totals sent, and the Action decides whether the supplier, currency and tax codes fit.

id.description: Only on a PUT: the id of a line the draft already has. A new order's lines get their ids from the server.

PurchaseOrderRequest.title: PurchaseOrderRequest

open_revision_id.description: Only on one order: the draft or pending revision, if there is one.

purchase_order.description: the live (not cancelled) order this line is on, if any

RateOverrideRequest.description: An average rate for a currency over a period, with the reason the default does not fit.

rate.description: Presentation-currency units per 1 unit of `currency`, an exact decimal with at most 8 decimals.

RateOverrideRequest.title: RateOverrideRequest

ReasonRequest.description: Why a run or entry is reversed or voided.
ReasonRequest.title: ReasonRequest

ReceiveFundTransferRequest.description: Records that the money arrived: the date, and (if different from the draft) the amount received and the rate of that day.
ReceiveFundTransferRequest.title: ReceiveFundTransferRequest

ReconciliationRequest.description: Start (`statement_id`), finish (optional `version`) or reopen (`reason`, optional `version`) a reconciliation.
ReconciliationRequest.title: ReconciliationRequest

RecurringInvoiceRequest.description: A recurring invoice or bill: the template is a posted invoice or bill.
RecurringInvoiceRequest.title: RecurringInvoiceRequest

RecurringJournalRequest.description: A recurring journal: the template is a posted manual journal.
RecurringJournalRequest.title: RecurringJournalRequest

ReportLayoutRequest.description: Save (or change) a report layout: a name, who sees it, and the report's parameters, as the report's query string takes them.

rule.description: Move with the calendar: this_month, last_month, this_year_to_date, last_year_to_date, or today (as-of reports). Leave out for a fixed period.

version.description: Send what you loaded: a stale value answers 409.

ReportLayoutRequest.title: ReportLayoutRequest

schedule.description: The owner's schedule in short, or null.

ReportScheduleRequest.description: Set or change a layout's scheduled email delivery, in friendly terms: how often, which day, which hour, which format, to whom.

month_day.description: Monthly and quarterly (January, April, July, October): a day from 1 to 28, or `last_day`.

hour.description: The hour of the day, 0 to 23, in the company's timezone.

recipient_user_ids.description: People of the company, by user id.

ReportScheduleRequest.title: ReportScheduleRequest

RequisitionRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft purchase requisition. The estimate is in the company's base
currency; totals are the server's. A line needs an item or a description.
RequisitionRequest.title: RequisitionRequest

ReverseJournalRequest.description: Optional `date` (YYYY-MM-DD; default per D3), `memo` and the `version` the reversal is based on.
ReverseJournalRequest.title: ReverseJournalRequest

RevisionRequest.description:
Propose (POST /purchase-orders/{id}/revisions) or replace (PUT /purchase-order-revisions/{id}) a revision of an approved
order. Supplier, currency, rate and order date are fixed. `version` is the order's version on POST (optional) and the
revision's on PUT (required). Lines carry the `id` of the order line they change; a line without one is new.

id.description: The id of a line this order already has; send it to keep the line's identity and what was received.

RevisionRequest.title: RevisionRequest

system.description: Plan 3c.25: a standard role keeps its name, Owner is locked completely, an edited standard role can be reset.

RuleOrderRequest.description: The full list of rule ids in the order they should run.
RuleOrderRequest.title: RuleOrderRequest

RunRecurringRequest.description: "Run now": create every draft due up to `as_of` (default: today), optionally for one schedule.
RunRecurringRequest.title: RunRecurringRequest

SendDocumentRequest.description: Recipients, and optionally the subject and message as edited; absent means the company's template.

from.description: Statements only: the period, and the side when the contact is both customer and supplier.

SendDocumentRequest.title: SendDocumentRequest

status.description: queued, sent (the mail server accepted it) or failed

current_password.description: Changing the signing PIN re-proves the password; the PIN itself is checked by PinPolicy.

SettlementRequest.description:
Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft receipt, payment or refund. Shape only: ids exist in this company, the
rate is a decimal string, the amount whole minor units. The base amount, the carried amounts and the exchange differences are the
server's. Allocations name an `invoice_id` or, for a refund of credit on account, a `source_settlement_id`. Dimensions are
`{"<dimension id>": "<dimension value id>"}`. `bank_account_id` (optional) names the bank account; it must be linked to `cash_account_id` and be in the settlement's currency.
SettlementRequest.title: SettlementRequest

has_email.description: False when the customer has no email address: flagged in the list and skipped by the run.

balance.description: Receivable balance at the end of the period, in the company's base currency; negative is a credit.

StatementRunRequest.description: The period of a statement run, as a date or an explicit period; a POST also names the customers.

basis.description: `as_of`: the three months ending on `as_of`; `period`: exactly `from` to `to`.

StatementRunRequest.title: StatementRunRequest

status.description: queued (on its way; follow it with `send_id`), skipped (no email, no balance, not a customer) or failed (the send path refused it).

reason.description: In plain words, for skipped and failed.

SubmitBillRequest.description: Submit a bill: a transition, plus the reason for going past a purchase order mismatch.

match_override_reason.description: Needs `bills.match_override`. Ignored when the bill matches.

SubmitBillRequest.title: SubmitBillRequest

SubmitInvoiceRequest.description: Submit an invoice: a transition, plus the reason for going past a customer's credit limit (plan 3c.12).

credit_limit_override_reason.description: Needs `invoices.override_credit_limit`, and someone who did not create or submit the invoice. Ignored when the limit holds.

SubmitInvoiceRequest.title: SubmitInvoiceRequest

TaxCodeRequest.description:
Create (POST: the code, and optionally its first rate) and replace (PUT: everything but the code, with the
`version` it was based on) a tax code. Rates are fractions as strings: "0.05" is 5%.
TaxCodeRequest.title: TaxCodeRequest

rate.description: The rate in force today as a fraction ("0.050000" is 5%); null when none is.

TaxGroupRequest.description: Create (POST) and replace (PUT: name and items, with the `version` it was based on) a tax group. Items are in sequence.
TaxGroupRequest.title: TaxGroupRequest

TaxPeriodRequest.description:
One request class for the tax period writes: generate (`authority`, `from`, `months`), save manual amounts (`version`, `amounts`),
file (`version`, `reference`) and reopen (`version`, `reason`). The route decides which rules apply.
TaxPeriodRequest.title: TaxPeriodRequest

TaxRateRequest.description: A new rate of a tax code from a date (inclusive), with the code's `version` it was based on.
TaxRateRequest.title: TaxRateRequest

source.description: Where the rate came from and when it was checked; null when nobody said.

TransitionRequest.description: A document transition (submit, approve): the version it was based on is optional, a comment too.
TransitionRequest.title: TransitionRequest

UploadImportRequest.description:
Multipart upload of a CSV or XLSX file: `kind` (contacts, accounts, opening_balances, invoices, bank_lines), `file` (up to
`imports.max_bytes`), optional `delimiter` for CSV (default: detected), and `options` — `number_locale` (us|eu|plain, default plain),
`date_format` (default Y-m-d) and the kind's own: `as_of` for opening balances, `bank_account_id` (and `sign`, `opening_balance`,
`closing_balance`) for bank lines. The file is read here and only its rows are kept. Row and column limits come from config.
UploadImportRequest.title: UploadImportRequest

UploadIntentRequest.description: POST …/attachments/uploads: what is being attached to, and the file's name, claimed type, size and SHA-256.
UploadIntentRequest.title: UploadIntentRequest

kind.description: approval_requested, approval_reminder, document_approved, document_returned, import_finished, import_failed, report_ready, report_failed, send_failed

link.description: Path inside the company; the SPA puts the company in front.

VersionRequest.description: A change that must name the version it was based on (13 §11): `{"version": 3}`.
VersionRequest.title: VersionRequest

WebhookEndpointRequest.description: Create or update an endpoint. `version` is required on update (the route has a webhook id).
WebhookEndpointRequest.title: WebhookEndpointRequest

WriteOffRecoveryRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft recovery: one posted write-off, the amount in the invoice's currency (up to what is not yet recovered) and the reason.
WriteOffRecoveryRequest.title: WriteOffRecoveryRequest

WriteOffRequest.description: Create (POST) or replace (PUT, with `version`) a draft write-off: one posted invoice, the amount in its currency (up to what is open) and the reason.
WriteOffRequest.title: WriteOffRequest

vat_note.const: Tax already declared on this invoice is not adjusted. Relief for bad debts depends on the country and is a manual step.

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.
